get.description: FE-062. Local-only, bounded (<=100 items) discovery of still-open recalls this Portal controlled on the exact resource: original_recall_id, currency, recipient, last known amounts and the five CAS counters. Requires independent current audit.read and exact current TS target membership, authorized BEFORE any private row read. No upstream lookup/write, no recovery. Untracked recalls (never controlled through the Portal) are not discoverable here; that needs a qualified source read and is stated in untracked_recalls.

PendingControlIntent.description: Named continuation of an existing recall only. Portal metadata and opaque policy revision stay outside exact pma.operator-control.v1. PORTFOLIO maps to PORTFOLIO; DEPLOYMENT maps to DEPLOYMENT_ACCOUNT. Runtime additionally requires recipient_deployment_id === resource.id; portable JSON Schema does not express arbitrary sibling-value equality. Five source CAS are int64 decimal STRINGS, never JS numbers. No amount, new recall, actor, URL or trusted source context can be supplied.

recipient_account_id.description: FE-063 (R-2c). Owning recipient account bound by the verified ORIGINAL intent and equal to the verified authorization recipient; non-null exactly when resource.kind is DEPLOYMENT, null for a PORTFOLIO recipient. Not a live source lookup, not browser-supplied after submission, never inferred from a label. Absent on pre-upgrade bodies, which are incomplete under this schema.

PendingControlStatus.description: Separate PENDING_RECALL_CONTROL family, not a new economic action. ACKNOWLEDGED iff source business is known. WAITING may have cumulative applied > 0 and continues QUERY_SAME_INTENT; terminal known states REVIEW_RECEIPT. UNKNOWN has no receipt/economics/blockers and queries except FAILED_BEFORE_SEND reviews its blocker. Physical transfer and economic cash change are false; no venue/projection confirmation is inferred. Runtime additionally checks chronology, exact source correlation, amount partitions and monotonicity. TEST_ONLY fixtures are not source qualification. Required currency is the exact immutable original intent unit, published only after current authority and original identity/hash validation. Historical stored status bytes remain unchanged and may omit currency; they are not served directly. Corrupt/unverifiable original intent refuses rather than guessing a unit. Pre-upgrade HTTP bodies without currency are incomplete under this public schema.

PendingRecallDiscoveryItem.description: One still-open recall this Portal controlled. WAITING_ENCUMBRANCE: last KNOWN source receipt shows an open remainder (cumulative applied may already be > 0); amounts and the five exact CAS counters are that receipt's and become the starting expected_versions, which the next preview rechecks against the source and which a later source change makes stale. UNKNOWN: a control was sent but no receipt is known; amounts/versions are null, never zero-filled. A terminal known outcome closes the recall, so it is not listed.

PendingRecallDiscovery.description: Local read-only discovery for ONE exact authorized resource, from the Portal's own pending-control history only (coverage PORTAL_CONTROLLED_RECALLS_ONLY). It is NOT a census of source recalls: a recall nobody controlled through the Portal is absent, and untracked_recalls states that as NOT_PUBLISHED / RECALL_REMAINDER_SOURCE_READ_NOT_QUALIFIED. original_recall_id is unique within items (runtime-enforced; JSON Schema uniqueItems cannot express a key-only uniqueness). truncated=true means more open recalls matched than the finite page holds and items are the newest. observed_at_ms is Portal evaluation time. Authorization: exact current audit.read plus TS-accepted correspondence on the resource, before any private row; hidden/wrong-workspace/unknown normalize to 404.
